input.summary:
P0 parlour furnished in parts/room-2.mjs: sofa of three stairs facing the west hearth across a red-carpet rug, fence-and-top-slab table with a candle, barrels with pots and a bookshelf on the north wall, two hanging lanterns and a standing lamp.
In a scratch build with shell-west but no ownership lock, `mcd room` says OK (walk 19/19, min light 10, no dark cells, FIT clean), and the scratch render reads as a parlour.
In the real make.sh the part placed 0 cells: all 28 writes were REFUSED because shell-west.mjs fills the room interior with air (lines 16, 20, 23), so runParts owns those cells.
left: Blocked by shared kit: shell-west.mjs fills the interior volumes with air (g.fill(..., 'air') at lines 16/20/23), and runParts marks every earlier write as owned, air included (build.mjs ~line 221). So every room part's writes are refused; all P0-P7 room parts place nothing. Fix belongs upstream: the shell should leave room interiors unwritten (the Grid is already air), or runParts should only own non-air writes. I did not edit shell-west or the library, and did not bypass the lock in the real build.

Once the lock is fixed, rerun ./make.sh and check that the parlour line reports 0 REFUSED. Then tick the parlour items in plan.md (the parlour and lighting items in elements.md) — not done here, since nothing reached build.nbt.
Scratch verification lives in /tmp/part9-scratch (unlocked.mjs builds shell-west plus this room without runParts; not part of the deliverable).

waste.what: Worked out the 3x7x3 furniture layout cell by cell by hand, then wrote it as three layers of text rows.
waste.cost: about 15 minutes of reasoning on stair facing, slab types and the fence-and-top-slab table height; one write, no retries on the layout itself
waste.tool: A room-layout helper that takes a semantic spec (sofa facing the hearth, table between seats, lamp height) and emits the layers() legend and rows, plus a stair facing calculator from the seat direction.

waste.what: Discovered the ownership lock blocks every room part only after running make.sh. Found it by reading runParts and shell-west by hand, then had to write a scratch build (unlocked.mjs) to get any walk, light or render check.
waste.cost: 3 make.sh runs and one scratch build script, about 4 minutes
waste.tool: `mcd room` or `runParts` should report, before any part runs, which cells of the room box are already owned by an earlier part and by which part; or a `--scratch` flag to build one part over the shell without the lock for a local check.

waste.what: Checked stair and carpet placement against the rest of the room by eye in the scratch render.
waste.cost: one render and one Read of the image
waste.tool: `mcd room --render` in the same run as the check, so a furnisher sees the furniture and the light map together.

companions.task: Stop writing air over room interiors in shell-west.mjs lines 16, 20 and 23 (or leave interiors unwritten) so the room parts can place their furniture; this is the blocker for all room parts.

Check the parlour's light map after the lock is fixed: the design uses two hanging lanterns (3,4,15) and (4,4,19), a candle on the table at (4,4,17) and a standing lamp at (3,3,20); the scratch light map gave min 10, so this is only a confirmation.

P0 parlour furnished in parts/room-2.mjs: sofa of three stairs facing the west hearth across a red-carpet rug, fence-and-top-slab table with a candle, barrels with pots and a bookshelf on the north wall, two hanging lanterns and a standing lamp.
In a scratch build with shell-west but no ownership lock, `mcd room` says OK (walk 19/19, min light 10, no dark cells, FIT clean), and the scratch render reads as a parlour.
In the real make.sh the part placed 0 cells: all 28 writes were REFUSED because shell-west.mjs fills the room interior with air (lines 16, 20, 23), so runParts owns those cells.
left: Blocked by shared kit: shell-west.mjs fills the interior volumes with air (g.fill(..., 'air') at lines 16/20/23), and runParts marks every earlier write as owned, air included (build.mjs ~line 221). So every room part's writes are refused; all P0-P7 room parts place nothing. Fix belongs upstream: the shell should leave room interiors unwritten (the Grid is already air), or runParts should only own non-air writes. I did not edit shell-west or the library, and did not bypass the lock in the real build.

Once the lock is fixed, rerun ./make.sh and check that the parlour line reports 0 REFUSED. Then tick the parlour items in plan.md (the parlour and lighting items in elements.md) — not done here, since nothing reached build.nbt.
Scratch verification lives in /tmp/part9-scratch (unlocked.mjs builds shell-west plus this room without runParts; not part of the deliverable).

waste.tool: A room-layout helper that takes a semantic spec (sofa facing the hearth, table between seats, lamp height) and emits the layers() legend and rows, plus a stair facing calculator from the seat direction.

waste.what: Discovered the ownership lock blocks every room part only after running make.sh. Found it by reading runParts and shell-west by hand, then had to write a scratch build (unlocked.mjs) to get any walk, light or render check.
